g.text: One sheet. Functional wiring is proposed; this is not a verified production circuit.

g.desc: One sheet. Functional wiring is proposed; this is not a verified production circuit.

g.text: U5 placeholder: 1 VCC, 2 INA, 3 INB, 4 VDD, 5 OUTB, 6/7 GND, 8 OUTA.

g.desc: U5 placeholder: 1 VCC, 2 INA, 3 INB, 4 VDD, 5 OUTB, 6/7 GND, 8 OUTA.

g.text: U5 alternative: DRV8212PDSGR. Different package/pins; redesign required.

g.desc: U5 alternative: DRV8212PDSGR. Different package/pins; redesign required.

g.text: H03: R3/R4 divider candidate: 1/2 VBAT. Capacitor values estimated.

g.desc: H03: R3/R4 divider candidate: 1/2 VBAT. Capacitor values estimated.

g.text: H02: programming and decoupling inferred. Unassigned GPIOs stay open; PPS prevents a unique functional pin guess.

g.desc: H02: programming and decoupling inferred. Unassigned GPIOs stay open; PPS prevents a unique functional pin guess.

g.text: H14-H15: J3 pin order and U6 LDO topology are low-confidence.

g.desc: H14-H15: J3 pin order and U6 LDO topology are low-confidence.

g.text: See docs/RECONSTRUCTION.md for evidence, alternatives, and calculations.

g.desc: See docs/RECONSTRUCTION.md for evidence, alternatives, and calculations.

g.text: H07: U2 matches SN74LVC2G14 (C14R, 6 pins). Q8 probably contains two switching devices; exact type unresolved.

g.desc: H07: U2 matches SN74LVC2G14 (C14R, 6 pins). Q8 probably contains two switching devices; exact type unresolved.

g.text: No capacitor value or rail voltage in this drawing was electrically measured.

g.desc: No capacitor value or rail voltage in this drawing was electrically measured.

g.text: H04: MX512H typical supply/output topology. Motor A/B and MCU control assignments remain hypotheses.

g.desc: H04: MX512H typical supply/output topology. Motor A/B and MCU control assignments remain hypotheses.

g.text: Selected working hypothesis: Ctop in series with (Cfront || Crear). Rear-bank vias suggest paired lower capacitors.

g.desc: Selected working hypothesis: Ctop in series with (Cfront || Crear). Rear-bank vias suggest paired lower capacitors.

g.text: Ceff = Ctop * (Cfront + Crear) / (Ctop + Cfront + Crear). Equal values give 2C/3 per enabled branch.

g.desc: Ceff = Ctop * (Cfront + Crear) / (Ctop + Cfront + Crear). Equal values give 2C/3 per enabled branch.

g.text: All-parallel and all-series banks remain alternatives. Emitter rail / collector orientation is provisional.

g.desc: All-parallel and all-series banks remain alternatives. Emitter rail / collector orientation is provisional.

g.text: DNP = unpopulated. An open pin means unresolved, not a certified no-connect.

g.desc: DNP = unpopulated. An open pin means unresolved, not a certified no-connect.

g.text: PIC GPIOs are intentionally unassigned where photographs cannot support a map.

g.desc: PIC GPIOs are intentionally unassigned where photographs cannot support a map.

g.text: PIR daughterboard internals are not yet traced; J3 represents its interface.

g.desc: PIR daughterboard internals are not yet traced; J3 represents its interface.

g.text: H01: likely S-1200B45 LDO. Nominal 4.5 V is a candidate, not a measured rail.

g.desc: H01: likely S-1200B45 LDO. Nominal 4.5 V is a candidate, not a measured rail.

g.text: U3 alternative: MCP6002-I/SN; same pin roles, electrical suitability to verify.

g.desc: U3 alternative: MCP6002-I/SN; same pin roles, electrical suitability to verify.

g.text: U2 and U3 use multiple symbol units on this same sheet, including supply units.

g.desc: H05: NPN interface candidate; bias destination unresolved.

g.desc: H13: 2H devices are probably PNP BJTs (MMBTA55 family; PBSS5140T is an alternative). Capacitor values unknown.
